SELECT ?point ?refnode ?tsid WHERE {
  ?point brick:isPointOf ?dev .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?refnode .
  ?refnode ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?point a ?ptcls .
  FILTER (regex(str(?dev), "#AHU01$") || regex(str(?dev), "#CondPump02$") || regex(str(?dev), "#HWPump01$"))
  FILTER (regex(str(?ptcls), "Power"))
}

SELECT ?point ?refnode ?tsid WHERE {
  ?point brick:isPointOf ?dev .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?refnode .
  ?refnode ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?point a ?ptcls .
  FILTER (strstarts(str(?dev), "http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#AHU01."))
}
